nodes.label: CI tests workflow (pytest + selfcheck)
nodes.rationale: Runs unit tests and the fake-binary selfcheck on ubuntu so the tool is verified without VASP or a cluster.

nodes.label: vasp-auto
nodes.rationale: Built around a two-machine model split by pip extras so each machine pulls only what it needs; VASP/POTCAR are proprietary and not shipped, QE is the free fallback.

nodes.label: Numbered job folders
nodes.rationale: One global counter names job dirs (0001_Fe, 0002_Si) so re-running never overwrites an earlier result.

nodes.label: Two-machine model (control vs remote)
nodes.rationale: Control machine runs UI/builders/results/SSH orchestration; remote compute node runs only the lean engine.

nodes.label: pip extras matrix
nodes.rationale: core=PyYAML only; results adds pandas/openpyxl; builder adds ase; local=full control machine; ml adds fairchem-core. UI server is pure stdlib so adds no runtime dependency of its own.

nodes.label: Lean remote engine
nodes.rationale: Offload builds an engine wheel that resolves only core (PyYAML), so a compute node never pulls pandas/openpyxl/ase; the CLI imports pandas lazily so the engine imports cleanly without it.

nodes.label: Calculation types / INCAR templates
nodes.rationale: --calc-type picks a pre-validated example/INCAR_<type>; a case-supplied INCAR always takes precedence, editable without Python.

nodes.label: Quantum ESPRESSO engine (engine: qe)
nodes.rationale: VASP needs a paid licence; QE (pw.x) is free and runs the same cases. The VASP env_setup is NOT sourced for QE because an Intel mpirun first on PATH would run an OpenMPI-built pw.x as N duplicate serial jobs; use qe_env_setup instead.

nodes.label: Generic ASE-calculator engine (engine: ase)
nodes.rationale: Drives any ASE calculator (EMT, DMol3, GPAW, MACE...); writes a self-contained run_ase.py + ase_calc.json so the job dir re-runs without vasp_auto, and emt is the default so the engine is testable anywhere.

nodes.label: Spin-polarised runs (--spin/--magmom)
nodes.rationale: --spin sets ISPIN=2 and derives MAGMOM from POSCAR composition; a MAGMOM already in the case INCAR is kept.

nodes.label: KPOINTS generation
nodes.rationale: --kmesh/--kspacing/--kpath with presets cubic/fcc/bcc/hex; --kpath auto detects lattice type in pure Python (no spglib) and errors on low-symmetry cells.

nodes.label: Workflow chaining (chained steps)
nodes.rationale: Outputs feed forward automatically (CONTCAR->POSCAR, CHGCAR for dos/bands). Priority: --workflow flag > case workflow.yaml > config workflow key. A leading converge step carries ENCUT/SIGMA/NELM/k-mesh into later steps.

nodes.label: Convergence scans (ENCUT/SIGMA/NELM/KPOINTS)
nodes.rationale: Sequential stages ENCUT->SIGMA->NELM->KPOINTS, each holding the selected value fixed. SIGMA picks the largest smearing whose T*S stays below sigma-tol (standard VASP guidance); --reuse-wavecar seeds each trial to cut wall time.

nodes.label: Structure building (pure Python + ASE)
nodes.rationale: Pure-Python operators (supercell/vacancy/substitute/interstitial/adsorbate/freeze/scale-cell) compose in command-line order; ASE-backed builders add bulk/slab/molecule/crystal/nanotube/CIF import.

nodes.label: ML pre-relaxation (OMat24/UMA)
nodes.rationale: MLIP minima sit within a few meV/atom of the PBE minimum, so the subsequent VASP relaxation converges in a fraction of the ionic steps; default backend is Meta FAIR UMA/OMat24 via fairchem-core, emt for a no-install demo.

nodes.label: Remote run over SSH (--remote)
nodes.rationale: run_mode ssh rsyncs inputs and runs mpirun synchronously; slurm/pbs submit sbatch/qsub over SSH then exit. env_setup is sourced before mpirun for non-interactive toolchains (Intel oneAPI/modules).

nodes.label: Offload mode (run_mode: ssh_detached)
nodes.rationale: Full engine runs on the remote under setsid so it covers iterative paths (convergence, chained workflows) and the laptop can power off; ships POSCAR + a pre-built POTCAR so the remote needs no POTCAR library.

nodes.label: Excel results summary
nodes.rationale: Styled xlsx with energy, convergence flag, Fermi, band gap, forces, pressure, magnetisation, NEB barriers, ionic steps, detected errors and queue job id, plus a per-case energy bar chart.

nodes.label: Self-check (fake VASP binaries)
nodes.rationale: 41 checks with fake mpirun/vasp_std/sbatch verify every feature on any machine in seconds without VASP or a cluster; everything it writes stays inside selfcheck/.

nodes.label: Implicit solvation (VASPsol)
nodes.rationale: --solvation injects LSOL=.TRUE. + EB_K; requires a VASPsol-patched binary or VASP aborts on the unknown LSOL tag.

nodes.label: Automatic error recovery (--auto-retry)
nodes.rationale: Known errors with a safe INCAR fix (EDDDAV->ALGO=All, RHOSYG->ISYM=0) are re-run up to N times; errors without a safe generic fix (TOO FEW BANDS) are never auto-fixed. Local scheduler only.

nodes.label: Web UI (vasp-auto-ui)
nodes.rationale: Separate stdlib-only package (http.server, binds 127.0.0.1) that calls the same engine functions as the CLI and launches runs through the CLI itself, so behaviour is identical; Build/Calculate/Workflow/Results tabs plus an OpenAI-compatible AI builder that only chooses the build command.

nodes.label: Combine two structures (deposition/heterostructure)
nodes.rationale: --combine stacks a guest on a host (default stack keeps host in-plane lattice; --combine-strain for epitaxy; insert mode drops guest atoms into the unchanged host cell).

nodes.label: Cell matching (--match-cells)
nodes.rationale: Searches commensurate supercell pairs bringing incommensurate host/guest into registry and prints strain per axis; large strain/angle means combine without --combine-strain.

nodes.label: Prototype crystals library
nodes.rationale: Pure-Python built-in library (graphene, graphite, rutile/anatase-TiO2, hBN) for compounds ASE's bulk() cannot build.

nodes.label: Retry failed (--retry-failed)
nodes.rationale: Reruns only unconverged cases: CONTCAR becomes the new POSCAR, WAVECAR/CHGCAR are kept as the SCF seed. Safe to repeat; the UI Resume button is the equivalent with an editable INCAR spreadsheet.

nodes.label: Cross-platform support (Linux/macOS/Windows)
nodes.rationale: Pure Python 3.12+ (pathlib, no platform syscalls, no symlink/chmod reliance); WSL2 recommended on Windows; planned CI matrix and a Python selfcheck runner.

nodes.label: MPI launcher & oversubscribe handling
nodes.rationale: mpirun by default, VASP_AUTO_MPI overrides it (mpiexec for MS-MPI/Intel). Open MPI counts physical cores as slots, so the runner adds --use-hwthread-cpus when ranks fit hardware threads or --oversubscribe when they exceed them; these flags are OpenMPI-specific and skipped for Intel/MS-MPI.

nodes.label: Start SSH service (remote enablement)
nodes.rationale: Snippet to start/check the sshd service so a machine can accept the remote-run/offload SSH connections.

nodes.label: NEB / TSS transition-state search
nodes.rationale: TSS case = initial/POSCAR + final/POSCAR auto-detected as NEB; climbing-image (LCLIMB) with ASE IDPP interpolation; barriers parsed as forward/backward. Relax endpoints tightly since loose forces propagate to all images.

nodes.label: Work function (W = V_vac - E_F)
nodes.rationale: workfunction template writes LOCPOT with LVHAR=.TRUE. (Hartree+ionic only, the correct reference) and LDIPOL/IDIPOL=3 to cancel the artificial field of asymmetric slabs; potential_profile.csv holds the planar-averaged V(z).

nodes.label: Optical absorption / dielectric function
nodes.rationale: LOPTICS static non-SCF run on a converged WAVECAR; --optics-parse writes absorption.csv and epsilon(0). Independent-particle approximation underestimates the optical gap and overestimates epsilon(0).

nodes.label: Adsorption energy (three-job)
nodes.rationale: E_ads = E(slab+ads) - E(slab) - scale*E(gas); all three energies must share ENCUT, k-density, smearing and pseudopotentials. --molecule-scale 0.5 references atomic H to half E(H2) for HER.

nodes.label: Computational hydrogen electrode (CHE)
nodes.rationale: mu(H+ + e-) = half mu(H2) at U=0 vs RHE, shifted by +eU. Free energies add ZPE+U_vib-TS from freq jobs; a good HER catalyst has dG_H* approx 0.

nodes.label: d-band center
nodes.rationale: First moment of the surface-atom d-projected DOS relative to E_F; higher (less negative) centers bind adsorbates more strongly.

nodes.label: Bader charges
nodes.rationale: Net charge = ZVAL(POTCAR) - Bader electrons; needs AECCAR0/AECCAR2 (LAECHG) and the Henkelman bader binary on PATH.

nodes.label: Charge-density difference (delta-rho)
nodes.rationale: delta-rho = rho(slab+ads) - rho(slab) - rho(ads); the three densities must be on identical FFT grids, so fragments are carved from the combined relaxed geometry without moving anything. --chg-diff refuses mismatched grids loudly.

nodes.label: Smoother First Run (example/Si + vasp-auto --init)
nodes.rationale: A fresh clone could not run the README Quickstart: it pointed at git-ignored inputs/Fe and example/ shipped only INCAR templates, so the first command failed 'target not found'; with no config.yaml the engine fell back to bare defaults that fail cryptically. Ships example/Si/POSCAR and --init to copy config.yaml.example.

nodes.label: Resume Unfinished Job In Place (CONTCAR to POSCAR, warm WAVECAR/CHGCAR)
nodes.rationale: Restart a job from the latest geometry VASP wrote without allocating a new NNNN job number or rebuilding inputs; reuses the job dir's own INCAR/KPOINTS/POTCAR, only POSCAR advances. Works local, ssh, and detached-offload (setsid so the host can power off).

nodes.label: Working-case UI Model
nodes.rationale: Whatever the user builds, imports or saves becomes the single working case that Calculate/Workflow/Remote all act on, replacing the old cases-folder + case-select pair.

nodes.label: Shared Machine List (config_loader.load_ui_remotes)
nodes.rationale: One source of truth for remotes: load_ui_remotes folds the UI's remotes.json into the CLI config so --remote NAME sees machines added in the UI, avoiding drift.

nodes.label: Build POTCAR on the Remote
nodes.rationale: For ssh_detached offload the engine already builds INCAR/KPOINTS remotely but the POTCAR was always built locally and shipped, tying every offload to a local POTCAR library. submit_job_detached now writes potcar_root into the remote config so the remote _copy_or_build_potcar builds it there; machines without potcar_root keep shipping a locally-built POTCAR.

nodes.label: Detached-run Collapse Diagnosis (WSL2 host suspend/logoff)
nodes.rationale: Root cause is NOT the detach mechanism: setsid survives an SSH drop on both machines. tlclab jobs die because its WSL2 host (a shared Windows desktop) suspends/resumes or the WSL owner logs off, tearing down the VM. apl2 (native Linux) runs fine. Fixes: never-sleep power settings + a WSL2 keepalive task.

nodes.label: KeepWSL2Alive Keepalive Task
nodes.rationale: A Windows scheduled task (AtStartup+AtLogon, S4U run-whether-logged-on-or-not) runs wsl.exe --exec tail -f /dev/null to hold the WSL2 VM up 24/7 so sshd/tailscaled stay reachable across logoff.

nodes.label: Analysis Tab (local analysis of local and remote results)
nodes.rationale: A dedicated tab where every analysis runs locally; remote jobs are captured automatically and the local copy analyzed. Mostly a reorganization + gap-filling of existing viewers, not a greenfield build.
nodes.norm_label: analysis tab (local analysis of local and remote results)

nodes.label: _analysis_dir Remote-capture Mechanism
nodes.rationale: The remote-capture problem is already solved: _analysis_dir(path, machine, heavy) returns the path for local machines, else rsyncs the job into REMOTE_RESULT_CACHE and pulls named heavy files on demand. Every analysis endpoint routes through it, so mixing machines in one analysis just works.

nodes.label: Free-energy Diagram / CHE Overpotential
nodes.rationale: The key screening tool: cumulative dG staircase at U=0 and U, potential-determining step, limiting potential U_L and overpotential vs an equilibrium potential (computational hydrogen electrode). A pure composition of adsorption_energy + thermo_from_job, no new physics parsing.

nodes.label: QE Parity for Energies (read_job_energy dispatch)
nodes.rationale: One dispatch in read_job_energy (parse_pw_output for qe jobs) makes adsorption/surface/dG diagrams engine-agnostic because they all sum energies through this single function.

nodes.label: Job-slot (path, machine) Component
nodes.rationale: Every analysis input is a (path, machine) pair; one reusable widget resolves through _analysis_dir, so multi-job analyses can mix machines (slab on tlclab, molecule local).

nodes.label: vasp_auto Engine (single source of truth)
nodes.rationale: The engine package is the only source of truth; CLI and UI call the same functions so they behave identically. Core stays pure-Python (no numpy), installable without ASE/fairchem.

nodes.label: Workflow-builder GUI Goal
nodes.rationale: Long-term goal: a GUI layer letting users pick a calc type, adjust params via forms, chain tasks, and view results without writing an INCAR by hand; must stay fully backward-compatible with the CLI.

nodes.label: Execution Model - Local vs Remote
nodes.rationale: runner.py owns all execution (local subprocess + everything SSH/remote); every calculate path must stay available on both local and any configured remote. Standing rule: don't put SSH calls outside runner.py.

nodes.label: Three Remote Run Modes (scheduler / ssh / ssh_detached)
nodes.rationale: scheduler (sbatch/qsub over SSH, laptop-off safe), ssh (synchronous mpirun, not laptop-off safe), ssh_detached (whole engine under setsid, laptop-off safe). Detached records the wrapper rc, so rc=0 does not mean VASP succeeded.
nodes.norm_label: three remote run modes (scheduler / ssh / ssh_detached)

nodes.label: Cross-machine Job Control (terminate/delete/resume)
nodes.rationale: One endpoint per action; the row's machine field selects local vs remote and the server acts over SSH for remote rows. Destructive remote paths validated against remote_root, local ones against jobs_root - boundary always from server config, never the client.

nodes.label: Job Status as Liveness Check (not file existence)
nodes.rationale: A job reads 'running' only if its recorded .pid is alive (kill -0) or a live process has its cwd inside the dir; 'done' needs a genuine finish signal (job.log / OUTCAR footer / QE JOB DONE / ase_results.json); dead-without-finishing is 'stalled'. The same rule lives in three places (local, remote shell walk, terminal_status) so every view agrees.
nodes.norm_label: job status as liveness check (not file existence)

nodes.label: Quantum ESPRESSO (pw.x) Engine
nodes.rationale: Open-source engine so users without a VASP licence can run the same cases; selected by engine=qe with a .engine marker file per job dir; works through all three remote run modes. NEB/phonon/convergence/chaining stay VASP-only.

nodes.rationale: Multi-step calcs with automatic file passing (CONTCAR->POSCAR, CHGCAR for dos/bands); the converge step runs a scan first and carries the chosen ENCUT/SIGMA/NELM/KPOINTS into later steps.
